user.title: DSC Neo: listener setup
user.description: Choose where Home Assistant should listen for connections from the TL280 communicator. The default port (3072) matches DSC's factory default. Use 0.0.0.0 to listen on all interfaces.

wait.title: Waiting for your panel to connect
wait.description:
Home Assistant is listening on {host}:{port}.

**Now configure the TL280 communicator on the panel keypad:**

1. Enter installer mode: ` * 8 [installer code] `
2. Section `[851][425]`: enable bits 3, 4, 5
3. Section `[851][428]`: set the IP address of this Home Assistant server
4. Section `[851][429]`: set the port in hex (e.g. `0C00` for 3072)
5. Exit installer mode: ` # # `

The panel will connect within a few seconds. Click **Submit** to check progress.

confirm.title: Confirm panel connection
confirm.description:
Detected panel **{integration_id}** (encryption type {encryption_type}).

Enter the Type 2 access code from section `[851][700]` (32 hex characters). Leave the default if you haven't changed it.

Optionally provide a Type 1 access code, a stored user PIN that the integration will use automatically for arm/disarm actions, and the installer code so we can read which zones/partitions are enabled. If the PIN is left empty, Home Assistant will prompt for one in the UI whenever an action requires it. Without the installer code, all 32+ zone slots will appear in HA. With it, only enabled zones do.

reauth_confirm.title: DSC Neo: re-enter access codes
reauth_confirm.description: The panel rejected the stored credentials (reason: {reason}). Re-enter the Type 2 access code (and any other codes that changed). The integration will reconnect automatically after saving.

error.invalid_type2_key: Type 2 access code must be exactly 32 hexadecimal characters.
error.invalid_type1_key: Type 1 access code must be exactly 8 digits.
error.port_in_use: This port is already in use by another service on this host. Pick a different port or stop the conflicting service.
error.host_unavailable: This bind address is not assigned to any interface on this host. Use 0.0.0.0 to listen on all interfaces.
error.bind_denied: Home Assistant doesn't have permission to bind this port (usually 1-1023). Pick a port above 1023.
error.bind_failed: Could not bind to the chosen address/port. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This panel (Integration ID) is already configured in Home Assistant.
abort.timeout_no_panel: Timed out waiting for the panel to connect. Verify the TL280 programming and try again.
abort.bind_failed: Could not bind to the chosen port. It may already be in use by another service.
abort.probe_failed: An unexpected error occurred while waiting for the panel. Check the Home Assistant logs.
abort.no_integration_id: The panel connected but didn't announce an Integration ID. Verify the TL280 firmware version and section [851][422].
abort.reconfigure_panel_changed: The connecting panel has a different Integration ID than the one being reconfigured. Add a new integration entry instead.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Reconfiguration complete. The integration has been reloaded with the new settings.
abort.reauth_successful: Credentials updated. The integration has been reloaded.

init.title: DSC Neo - update access codes
init.description:
Edit the access codes for this panel. Leave any field unchanged to keep its current value.

* **Type 2 key** - 32-character hex from section [851][700].
* **Type 1 key** - 8-digit code, only used if your panel is configured for Type 1 encryption.
* **User PIN** - if set, used automatically for arm/disarm; if blank, HA prompts each time.
* **Installer code** - enables "Reload panel config" so HA can read which zones/partitions are enabled. Default is `5555`.

Saving will reload the integration.

error.invalid_type2_key: Type 2 access code must be exactly 32 hexadecimal characters.
error.invalid_type1_key: Type 1 access code must be exactly 8 digits.

sensor_reset.description: Reset latched alarm sensors (2-wire smoke detectors, glass-break devices). Equivalent to [*][7][2] at the keypad.

command_output.description: Activate a panel programmable output (PGM). Equivalent to [*][7][N] at the keypad.

trouble_communications.title: DSC Neo: Communications trouble
trouble_communications.description: The panel is reporting a Communications trouble (Trouble 11 - typically TLM, FTC, Cellular, or Ethernet). Check the relevant communicator path; see the panel's `[*][2]` menu for the specific sub-item.

trouble_ac_loss.title: DSC Neo: AC power loss
trouble_ac_loss.description: The panel is reporting AC trouble (Trouble 04). The panel is running on battery. Check the panel transformer and household power.

trouble_battery.title: DSC Neo: Low / missing battery
trouble_battery.description: The panel is reporting a Battery trouble (Trouble 02). The backup battery is low, missing, or one of the auxiliary supplies has a battery fault.

trouble_service_required.title: DSC Neo: Service required
trouble_service_required.description: The panel is reporting Service Required (Trouble 01) - typically a bell-circuit, RF-jam, aux-supply, output, or loss-of-clock condition. Check the panel's `[*][2]` menu for the specific sub-item.

auth_failed.title: DSC Neo: Authentication failed
auth_failed.description:
Home Assistant could not authenticate to the panel. This usually means the configured Type 2 access code does not match section `[851][700]` on the panel, or the panel rejected our handshake. Update the access code via the integration's options (gear icon) and the connection will retry automatically.

Details: {reason}
